description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three large language models—Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD—across two distinct tasks: Classification and Generation, as evaluated in the paper “Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners? A Comprehensive Evaluation and Beyond.” The vertical axis represents Accuracy, scaled from 0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2, while the horizontal plane displays the model names along the depth axis and the task types (Classification, Generation) along the width axis, forming a 3D grouped bar structure. Each model has two bars corresponding to the two tasks, with color gradients transitioning from blue at the base to yellow at the top, likely indicating a visual emphasis on higher performance. For Classification, Davinci-003 achieves approximately 0.5 accuracy, ChatGPT around 0.3, and BARD about 0.6. For Generation, Davinci-003 reaches roughly 0.8, ChatGPT approximately 0.6, and BARD about 0.7. The chart visually suggests that Davinci-003 performs best on Generation, while BARD leads on Classification, and ChatGPT consistently underperforms relative to the other two models across both tasks. The bars are not sorted by height, and no explicit error bars or statistical annotations are present.
